While examining the collateral file, I discovered that $1,500,000 of the reported $10,000,000 in receivables are actually invoices owed by entities under the borrower's common ownership. Our policy excludes related-party receivables, which means the true eligible receivable base is $8,500,000. Applying the 80% advance rate, the maximum commitment we can support is $6,800,000 — not $8,000,000. I should also note that this finding has not yet been entered into the credit system, and that an approved renewal at this risk level requires a monthly borrowing-base certificate.
